claim: The City of Johannesburg's public announcement reports that its climate-risk assessment projects severe flooding exposure by 2050. This is context for investigating runoff and access risk, not evidence that a proposed rainwater intervention will work.

coverage.place_label: City of Johannesburg (source-described; mapped resolution not verified)

method.description: Manual summary of the municipal announcement. The underlying assessment data and model files have not been retrieved or independently examined.

uncertainty.description: The announcement alone does not establish the underlying model version, scenario settings, spatial resolution, uncertainty range, or neighborhood-level interpretation.

review.rationale: Initial source-grounded note only; independent technical and local review has not occurred.

limitations: This is a secondary summary of a municipal announcement, not the source dataset.
Citywide flood exposure does not establish conditions at a particular parcel, crossing, or corridor.
This evidence does not establish the effectiveness, safety, soil suitability, or maintenance feasibility of infiltration or rainwater-capture interventions.
